name: Love Formula
source:
Love Formula is a visual novel exclusively for adults! This game will immerse you in the story of two college students who are working on a chemistry project. At some point, one of them accidentally creates an aphrodisiac... The game is filled with sex scenes, humor and romance.

In this wonderful game, you will plunge into the story of two college students who are working on a chemistry project. Alexander and Lucy have worked very hard on the insect repellant. At some point, without knowing it, Alexander, in a fit of rage, creates an aphrodisiac. What happened next you will see in the game. Get real pleasure from a very simple gameplay and cool music.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2155980/Love_Formula/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《爱情公式》是一部专为成人打造的视觉小说！该游戏将让你沉浸在两名正在进行化学项目的大学生的故事中。在某个时刻，他们中的一个人意外地制造出了一种春药……游戏充满了性爱场面、幽默和浪漫。

在这款精彩的游戏中，你将沉浸在两名正在进行化学项目的大学生的故事中。亚历山大和露西在驱虫剂上付出了很大的努力。在某个时刻，亚历山大在不知情的情况下，在盛怒之下创造了一种春药。接下来发生的事情你将在游戏中看到。从非常简单的游戏和酷炫的音乐中获得真正的乐趣。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2155980/Love_Formula/]Steam[/url]]
